content.prompt: The diagram below shows the stages in the production of olive oil. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

steps.label: Harvesting
steps.detail: Ripe olives are shaken from the trees onto nets in autumn

steps.label: Sorting
steps.detail: Leaves and twigs are removed by a blower

steps.label: Washing
steps.detail: The olives are rinsed in cold water

steps.label: Crushing
steps.detail: Stone wheels grind whole olives, including the stones, into a paste

steps.label: Mixing
steps.detail: The paste is stirred slowly for 30 minutes so that droplets of oil join together

steps.label: Pressing
steps.detail: The paste is spread on mats and pressed to release liquid

steps.label: Separating
steps.detail: A centrifuge spins the liquid to separate oil from water

steps.label: Storing
steps.detail: The oil rests in steel tanks for a month so that sediment settles

steps.label: Bottling
steps.detail: The oil is filtered and put into dark glass bottles

steps.label: Reservoir
steps.detail: A dam holds back river water in a high reservoir

steps.label: Intake
steps.detail: Gates in the dam open and water enters a large pipe

steps.label: Descent
steps.detail: Water flows down the pipe, gaining speed

steps.label: Turbine
steps.detail: The moving water turns the blades of a turbine

steps.label: Generator
steps.detail: The turbine drives a generator, which produces electricity

steps.label: Transformer
steps.detail: The voltage is raised for long-distance transmission

steps.detail: Cables carry the electricity to towns and factories

steps.label: Outflow
steps.detail: The water leaves the turbine and returns to the river below the dam

steps.label: Picking
steps.detail: Ripe coffee cherries are picked by hand

steps.label: Drying
steps.detail: The cherries are spread out in the sun for two weeks

steps.label: Hulling
steps.detail: A machine removes the dried skin to leave green beans

steps.label: Roasting
steps.detail: The beans are roasted at 200 degrees until dark brown

steps.label: Grinding
steps.detail: The roasted beans are ground into coarse powder

steps.label: Brewing
steps.detail: The grounds are mixed with hot water and the liquid is strained

steps.label: Freezing
steps.detail: The strong coffee is frozen into a thin sheet at minus 40 degrees

steps.label: Breaking
steps.detail: The frozen sheet is broken into granules

steps.label: Vacuum drying
steps.detail: The granules pass through a vacuum so that the ice turns straight to vapour

steps.label: Packing
steps.detail: The dry granules are sealed in jars

title: The life cycle of the salmon

content.prompt: The diagram below shows the life cycle of the salmon. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

chart.title: The life cycle of the salmon

steps.label: Eggs
steps.detail: In autumn, eggs are laid in gravel in the upper part of a river

steps.label: Hatching
steps.detail: After about three months the eggs hatch into tiny fish that stay hidden in the gravel

steps.label: Fry
steps.detail: The young fish emerge and feed on insects in shallow, fast water

steps.label: Parr
steps.detail: For one to three years they grow in the river, marked with dark bars

steps.label: Smolt
steps.detail: They turn silver and swim downstream to the river mouth

steps.label: Ocean life
steps.detail: Adults spend one to four years feeding at sea, growing to 70 cm or more

steps.label: Return
steps.detail: Adults swim back up the river where they were born, leaping over waterfalls

steps.label: Spawning
steps.detail: Females dig nests in the gravel and lay eggs; most adults then die
